text.p: - Controversial deputy secretary of the Ruissian Security Council Boris Berezovsky said in the interview with the paper that he gave up Isreali citizenship. But the paper's independent research could not confirm it.
- Russian economy is unable to survive under the burden of the exosting taxes, says Andrei Illarionov, the head of the Economic Analysis Insitute.

- The Chairman of the Federal Energy Committee Yuri Korsun made a sensational statement yesterday that Russia is going to lift the government regulation of the electricity and energy tariffs by the year 2000. This statement was probably meant to impress the International Monetary Fund mission that arrived in Moscow yesterday.
- The Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov's visit to Italy is apparently aimed at finding common grounds on the issue of NATO expansion.
- Cancellation of Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin's visit to Kiev may further aggravate relations between the two countries.
- Russia has official agreements on dual citizenship with only two countries - Turkmenia and Tajikistan, says the Chairman of the presidential committee on citizenship Oleg Kutafin.
- The Pensions Fund was brought to bankruptcy by the government's apparent mismanagement.
- Russia's top polititians are able to use any means to achieve their current goals, sais the paper's analist looking back at one the biggest election scandals.
